primary_certificate_obstruction: Direct all-support necessary condition for any finite strictly-negative-coordinate atom certificate on every independent stable odd-degree box: after merging repeated positive frequencies, the even and odd parity sign words each contain oriented (-,+,-,+,... ) subsequences. Consequently there must be an actual backward root-count/sign crossing inside some even root band AND an actual backward crossing inside a different disjoint odd root band; each band contains two distinct selected nodes. Thus any grid with at most one positive node per even band, or at most one per odd band, is incapable of producing a strict negative certificate regardless of how many nodes lie elsewhere. This constrains the original strict certificate directly, not only zero annihilators.
unbounded_norm_obstruction: The explicit all-R>=1000 solvable stable full-width family forces ||b||_1/sup_K||a||_1>(33/1300)R for every common monic b; its constructive witness achieves ratio ~(2902/8425)R. Therefore even a global fixed multiplicative norm cap fails, with sharp order Theta(R). This also holds for any coefficient lp norm in fixed dimension.
unbounded_ray: Every box in the same parametric family, at any interior radial factor, has an explicit degree-six finite-frequency-positive direction c_R, with all seven coefficients positive. The equal-degree common monic numerators b_R+tau*c_R for tau>=0 form an unbounded ray in every nonleading coefficient. The degree-six c_R itself is not called SPR under the equal-degree definition. Exact symbolic replay checked 627 strictly positive shifted coefficients, five tangencies and ten contact divisions for all R>=100.
improved_upper: An independently certified alternate common numerator b_R-(17/500)R^2*d_R, R>=500, has b6<(20611/168500)R^2. The auxiliary d_R is not asserted positive. Combined with the R>=5000 all-numerator dual lower (7/80)R^2 and lower asymptotic 8/91, the optimal b6 asymptotic bracket is [8/91,20611/168500] without asserting the optimum limit exists. Exact replay checked 1640 positive shifted coefficients and a low/high frequency split.
remaining_gap: The reversed bands are necessary, not sufficient; the original unrestricted problem remains open, and the explicit family has common numerators. No all-negative-coordinate certificate or universal positive theorem is established.
next_action: Investigate whether backwards-band conditions can be sharpened into a genuine global certificate obstruction or used in a targeted exact counterexample search.
